From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc:
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Final pulse tally & stakeholder sweep — Q4 close readiness

Team / Acme —

We’re inside the final 72 -> 48 window for Q4 close. To make the daily rollups useful, please do the following by EOD tomorrow (Tue 11/10, 5:00pm PT):

- Update the attached "q4_close_rollup_template.xlsx" with the current Stage, ARR, Probability, and expected booking date for any deal you own. Highlight any PO or legal blockers in the "Blockers" column.
- If there’s a finance gating item (billing terms / discount approval / SOW amount variance), add a one-line note and tag David.
- If you have a confirmed commit, mark the row "COMMIT" and paste the PO or DocuSign link in the Doc link column.

I’ll aggregate inputs and run a 48-hour health + cash visibility matrix each morning at 8:30am PT starting Wed 11/11. Expect a short standup cadence (10–12 minutes) for any exceptions.

Acme — Olivia / Sales team: we have one open PO in flight. If you can confirm counterparty signoff or provide the PO number by EOD Tue, we can include you in the confirmed commit bucket for Wednesday’s recon.

Attachments: q4_close_rollup_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
